entries.summary: A full online store for a handcrafted home décor brand — browse, wishlist, pay and track an order, with an admin desk the owner runs alone.
entries.photoNote: Beautify Interior storefront — home page with the featured collection
brief: Beautify Interior sells handcrafted décor — metal pen stands, wall art, lighting, idols and showpieces. The brand needed a store of its own: a place to show the full range properly and take orders directly, instead of living inside marketplace listings and chat threads.

We built the whole thing end to end: a fast storefront with category browsing, search, filters and sorting; product pages with galleries and stock; cart, wishlist and accounts; Razorpay checkout; and order tracking after the sale.
entries.approach: Keep the shop out of the product's way. Photography leads, the interface stays quiet, and every page is one clear step from the next — category to product to cart to paid. Then give the owner an admin desk simple enough to run without calling us.
deliverables: Storefront — home, categories, search, filters and sorting
Product pages — galleries, stock, offers, Chat & Buy
Cart, wishlist, accounts and Razorpay checkout
Admin desk — products, inventory, orders, coupons, customers, reports

gallery.caption: Catalogue — category filters and sorting across the full range
Product page — gallery, pricing, stock and three ways to buy

entries.outcome: A small brand doesn't need a marketplace to sell online. It needs its own shelf, a checkout it can trust, and a back office it can run alone.
